title: Watchlist "personal breadth" indicator widget
description: Surface the new personal-breadth proxy (backend-watchlist-breadth-proxy) as a small widget on the watchlist page (e.g. '9 of 15 watchlist tickers are currently BULLISH') -- explicitly framed as a lightweight stand-in for true market breadth (NH-NL etc.), not the real thing, since it only reflects the user's own tracked tickers rather than the whole market. Be honest about this distinction in the explanation content rather than letting it read as more authoritative than it is.

checklist.step: Design and implement the breadth widget on the watchlist page.
MetricHelp/inline content explicitly framing this as a personal-watchlist proxy, not true market breadth, with a one-line explanation of why (no broad-universe data source, per docs/ideas.md).
Tests + Storybook story; confirm 90% coverage gate holds.

decisions.decision: New feature component `PersonalBreadthCard` under `features/watchlist/components/` (not `components/common/`), rendered directly on `WatchlistPage` above the existing `WatchlistTable`, owning its own `useWatchlistBreadth` (`GET /api/watchlist/breadth`) fetch/loading/error state -- following the exact same pattern as `features/portfolio/components/RiskSummaryCard.tsx` on the Dashboard page (a feature card that owns its own query and is composed directly into a thin page).
decisions.rationale: Every value this widget renders (a tracked ticker, a Screen 1/Tide trend count) is a Triple Screen/watchlist domain concept, not a generic display primitive, so it fails Frontend.md §3's common/-vs-feature placement test for `components/common/` the same way RiskSummaryCard/SellFlaggedPositionsCard do -- it composes existing common/ primitives (StatCard, MetricHelp, EmptyState, ErrorState, LoadingState) rather than duplicating any of their behavior. Rejected alternative: bolting the widget's markup directly into WatchlistPage.tsx itself, which would violate Frontend.md §3's 'pages stay thin, no business logic' rule the same way DashboardPage avoids inlining RiskSummaryCard's own logic.

The add-frontend-feature skill's own Storybook requirement (Frontend.md §4) is scoped to `components/common/` components -- confirmed by precedent: `RiskSummaryCard.tsx` and `SellFlaggedPositionsCard.tsx` (the two closest analogues, same 'feature card that owns its own query' shape) have colocated tests but no `.stories.tsx` file. `PersonalBreadthCard` isn't a domain-agnostic display primitive callers pass props into (it fetches its own data internally), so a story would need MSW-mocked network state Storybook doesn't provide out of the box here, the same reason those two cards don't have one either. Its every state (loading, error, empty, mixed breakdown, all-unavailable, singular-count wording) is instead covered directly in `PersonalBreadthCard.test.tsx` against MSW-mocked responses.

decisions.decision: `watchlistKeys.breadth` (`['watchlist', 'breadth']`) nests under `watchlistKeys.all`, so `useAddWatchlistItem`/`useRemoveWatchlistItem`'s existing `invalidateQueries({ queryKey: watchlistKeys.all })` also refetches the breadth query via TanStack Query's prefix-matching invalidation. A portfolio-side edit (adding/removing a position on the Portfolio page) is deliberately *not* wired to invalidate this query, even though the breadth denominator spans the watchlist+portfolio union.
decisions.rationale: Mirrors `portfolioKeys.risk`'s own nesting rationale (features/portfolio/hooks/queryKeys.ts) for the watchlist-side edits, which are the common case for a widget placed on the Watchlist page itself. Cross-invalidating from `useAddPosition`/`useDeletePosition` (in `features/portfolio/hooks/`) would require either that feature importing `watchlistKeys` (a feature-to-feature dependency Frontend.md's module layout doesn't otherwise have anywhere) or a new shared cross-feature query-key module -- both heavier than accepting that the breadth widget can be up to `staleTime` (60s, `main.tsx`'s global QueryClient default, already the accepted staleness window used by e.g. `useStockAnalysis`) stale after a portfolio-only edit made on a different page. Rejected alternative: a standalone top-level `['breadth']` query key not nested under either feature's prefix, which would lose the free invalidation-on-watchlist-edit behavior entirely for no benefit.

decisions.decision: Widget layout: a heading ('Personal Breadth (Watchlist + Portfolio)') with a `MetricHelp` balloon, three `StatCard`s (Bullish/Bearish/Neutral, each showing count + percentage), an `EmptyState` when nothing is tracked yet, and a small caption footnote naming `unavailable_count` when it's non-zero -- rather than a single-sentence widget matching the task description's literal example ('9 of 15 watchlist tickers are currently BULLISH').
decisions.rationale: The backend's response spans three trend buckets (BULLISH/BEARISH/NEUTRAL) plus an explicit unavailable count, not just a single BULLISH fraction -- showing only the BULLISH count would silently discard the BEARISH/NEUTRAL breakdown and the honesty-relevant unavailable-ticker signal the backend task deliberately added (rather than guessing or dropping unavailable tickers). Reused `StatCard` (already used identically by RiskSummaryCard/DashboardPage) rather than inventing a new stat-tile component, per the skill's 'check for an existing common/ component before building a new one' step. The dynamic sentence form ('X of Y tracked tickers are currently BULLISH...') from the task description instead lives in the `MetricHelp` balloon's `valueInterpretation` (`personalBreadthHelp.ts`), where it's paired with the full BULLISH/BEARISH/NEUTRAL/unavailable breakdown plus the honest personal-proxy framing, rather than being the widget's only visible content.

comments.summary: PersonalBreadthCard.tsx:45 passes `alignItems="center"` directly as a prop on MUI's `<Stack>` instead of this codebase's established `sx={{ alignItems: 'center' }}` convention (every other `<Stack>` usage in the repo uses `sx`). This fails `tsc -b --noEmit` (TS2769, 'No overload matches this call') -- the exact command `yarn build` and the static-verify skill run -- so `yarn build` genuinely fails on this branch, even though the PR's own stated test plan (`yarn tsc --noEmit`, without `-b`) passed because it type-checks against a different, less strict config and missed it. It also reproduces live: a real browser walkthrough and the persisted e2e suite (`make e2e`, tests/e2e/watchlist.spec.ts) both show a React console error on every WatchlistPage load: "React does not recognize the `alignItems` prop on a DOM element ... spell it as lowercase `alignitems`". Confirmed independently by both my own `tsc -b --noEmit`/`yarn build` runs and a separate code-review pass. Blocking: fix by switching to `sx={{ alignItems: 'center' }}`.

Non-blocking: unavailable-count footnote pluralizes 'ticker(s)' off unavailable_count instead of the total tracked_ticker_count it's grammatically attached to (e.g. unavailable_count=1, tracked_ticker_count=5 renders 'ticker' instead of 'tickers'), and is locked in verbatim by a PersonalBreadthCard.test.tsx assertion. Tracked in frontend-breadth-widget-followups.

Non-blocking: personalBreadthHelp.ts's unavailableClause has the same pluralization bug ('tracked ticker(s)' keyed off unavailableCount rather than trackedTickerCount), inconsistent with the correct computable-based pluralization two lines later in the same function. Tracked in frontend-breadth-widget-followups.

Non-blocking: personalBreadthHelp.ts's valueInterpretation sentence always uses the plural verb 'are' even when computable=1 (e.g. '1 of 1 computable ticker (100.0%) are currently BULLISH' should be 'is'), also pinned verbatim by a test. Tracked in frontend-breadth-widget-followups.

review.notes: Backend+frontend test suites pass (backend 99.92% coverage, frontend 99.55%/98.76%/99.65%/99.64% statements/branches/functions/lines, 534 tests). Backend ruff/mypy clean; frontend eslint clean. `yarn tsc -b --noEmit` / `yarn build` fail (blocking, see comments). Live browser walkthrough via Playwright (fixture data provider) covered populated, empty, mixed BULLISH/BEARISH/NEUTRAL breakdown (verified the backend's independent-per-bucket-rounding quirk, e.g. 33.3+33.3+33.3=99.9, renders correctly since the widget shows three independent StatCards rather than a stacked bar or an implied 100% total -- no visual or textual confusion from the quirk), and an error state (PersonalBreadthCard's ErrorState renders independently of the watchlist table below it, which still loads fine) -- all functioned correctly apart from the alignItems console error. `make e2e` (16/16 specs) passes, reproducing the same alignItems console error. Component placement (feature, not common/) and no-Storybook-story decisions verified against the RiskSummaryCard precedent they cite -- both true (RiskSummaryCard.tsx has no .stories.tsx, is a feature card owning its own query). No backend/API changes in this PR, so no openapi.json regeneration was needed. No checklist item phrased as 'decide X' was left undecided. Sending back to implementing for the alignItems fix; the three grammar nits are filed as frontend-breadth-widget-followups rather than blocking this PR.
